name: LINXX Disposable Vapes - Orange Bomb - Sativa
description: MKX and Pressure Pack are shaking up the vape scene with Linxx! This collab brings the raw energy of MKX and the rhythm of Pressure Pack into a cutting-edge device. Linxx isn't just a vape; it's a revolution with patented tech linking two devices for endless flavor combos. With over 100 mixes, Linxx lets you vibe however you want, from chill to amp'd up!
